evals.prompt: We are ready to merge this branch. Find out what the repository requires for the merge gate and run the CI command it names.
evals.expected_output: The agent consults the operations quality reference, jumps to the CI and merge-gate section of owner/docs/operations/engineering_quality_and_delivery.md, cites that heading, and runs the named command before reporting a result.
expectations: references/operations/engineering_quality_and_delivery.md is consulted before the source document is read in full.
The consulted source heading is named in the response.
No gate result is claimed without observed command output.
The recorded digest is reported as matched, refreshed, or unavailable.

evals.prompt: A previous turn already read the operations quality document for the resource-lease rules. Now I need the same lease rule again to release a shared test environment.
evals.expected_output: The agent uses the existing reference to reach the resource-lease section directly, without reading the whole source document again, and cites the lease heading it applied.
expectations: The agent does not re-read the whole source document from the top.
The resource-lease section is located through the recorded section map or heading search.
The lease rule applied is cited by heading.

evals.prompt: Summarize the arguments in our product README so I can paste the summary into a release announcement.

expectations: No merge-gate, lease, CI, or delivery-checklist workflow is invoked.
